content.subject: Finance integration at Stord
content.draft_text:
Hi Stephanie,
You were CFO at Butterfly Network and led finance at Amazon. That often expands intercompany reconciliation workload, creating manual effort across finance and operations teams. We build scripts that pull transaction data from ERP, match it against subsidiary ledgers, generate adjustment entries, and reconcile line‑item balances automatically, feeding results back into reporting tools. Worth a 15‑minute call next week?
